description: This file defines an interface 'TwigCallableInterface' for the Twig template engine. It specifies a contract for callable entities within Twig, including methods for retrieving names, types, callables, node classes, and other properties related to function or method behavior in Twig templates.

classes.name: TwigCallableInterface
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for callable entities in Twig templates, specifying methods for name retrieval, callable information, node class, context requirements, arguments, deprecation info, and variadic capabilities.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the callable entity.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the callable entity.

methods.name: getDynamicName
methods.description: Returns the dynamic name of the callable, if applicable.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Retrieves the actual callable, which could be a callable object, an array with class and method, or null.

methods.name: getNodeClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the node associated with this callable.

methods.name: needsCharset
methods.description: Indicates whether a charset is needed for this callable.

methods.name: needsEnvironment
methods.description: Indicates whether an environment is required.

methods.name: needsContext
methods.description: Indicates whether context information is needed.

methods.name: withDynamicArguments
methods.description: Creates a new instance with specified dynamic arguments.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the arguments for the callable.

methods.name: isVariadic
methods.description: Checks if the callable accepts a variable number of arguments.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Indicates whether the callable is deprecated.

methods.name: getDeprecatingPackage
methods.description: Returns the package that deprecates this callable.

methods.name: getDeprecatedVersion
methods.description: Returns the version in which this callable became deprecated.

methods.name: getAlternative
methods.description: Returns an alternative callable or null.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of required arguments.
